subject: Goal calibration & measurement rubric — Q3 kickoff
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: OKR Owners <okrs@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Goal calibration & measurement rubric — Q3 kickoff

Team —

Attached is the draft Q3 measurement rubric (v2) I pulled together after last week's owners huddle. High-level asks:

- Please review the success criteria for each objective (tab: Criteria). I tightened some thresholds where we saw slack in Q2.
- Flag any targets you think are unrealistic or that would encourage the wrong trade-offs.
- Add suggested leading indicators (tab: Signals) — prefer short lists (1–3) per objective.

Timing: can I get edits or explicit thumbs-up by EOD Wednesday (2028-05-23)? We need this finalized to seed the QBR packet and the metrics dashboard.

Key notes: I called out two risky metrics under Platform Cost where we don't have full telemetry yet — I've annotated owners and a mitigation (prefix caching rollout).

Attachment: Q3_measurement_rubric_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet; 4 tabs)

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Product Strategy | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: OKR Owners <okrs@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 13:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Goal calibration & measurement rubric — Q3 kickoff

Markus — thanks for pulling this together. Quick reads/asks:

- On Objective 2 (Serving Runtime Efficiency) the success threshold moves from 15% to 10% P95 reduction. I think 10% is aggressive given current backlog of kernel work; request we keep 12% as a compromise.
- Signals: I'll add queue depth and cold-start rate as the two leading indicators.
- Telemetry gap: I'll sync with Infra (cc'd via separate note) to ensure we have the right event names for the cost breakdown.

I'll upload a marked copy to the Confluence page by EOD Tuesday.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: OKR Owners <okrs@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Sara Milton <sara@heliosanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Goal calibration & measurement rubric — Q3 kickoff

Looping Sara from Helios — she reviewed an earlier framework and has a short suggestion on the measurement language that might help with QBR clarity.

Two notes from my side:

1) Customer-facing metrics (Objective 4) — we should separate "adoption" (active routes) from "value" (rate of positive NPS/usage growth). They often get conflated in internal language.
2) Readout format — for QBR slide deck I'd prefer a one-slide view per objective: objective statement, 1x key metric, 2x leading indicators, and current status (R/Y/G + delta). Will save time in exec review.

Sara: if you have a 1–2 sentence edit to the success language for Objective 4, paste it here and I'll fold it in.

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: OKR Owners <okrs@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Sara Milton <sara@heliosanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Goal calibration & measurement rubric — Q3 kickoff

Appreciate the quick back-and-forth. Summary / next steps: 

- Kimberly: adjust Platform Efficiency threshold to 12% and upload marked rubric by EOD Tuesday.
- Grace: I'll adopt the one-slide-per-objective template for the QBR packet; please coordinate with Design for the visual.
- Aditya: please validate the revenue attribution signal for Objective 1 (Growth) and confirm events by COB tomorrow.
- Sara: welcome input — if you can paste the suggested Objective 4 language later today we'll include it verbatim and credit Helios in the draft.

I've attached a short checklist for QBR prep (QBR_prep_checklist_v1.docx) — it contains deadlines and the allowed appendix materials for execs. Once owners confirm I'll lock the rubric and convert to slides for the 2028-06-01 dry run.

Attachment: QBR_prep_checklist_v1.docx

If everyone is OK, reply-all with a brief "ACK" so we have a clear sign-off.

Markus
VP, Product Strategy | Redwood Inference
